item.title: Sharel Cassity Quartet feat. Michael Rodriguez at Offbeat Roadhouse - WTJU 91.1 FM
item.description: On April 3rd, Offbeat Roadhouse welcomes an electrifying collaboration as the Sharel Cassity Quartet takes the stage with special guest Michael Rodriguez, one of today’s most dynamic voices on trumpet. Cassity—an internationally acclaimed saxophonist, DownBeat’s 2023 Rising Star Alto Saxophonist, and the Director of Jazz Performance at UVA—brings her signature blend of fiery improvisation, soulful lyricism, and deep-rooted swing.
